l.i: Haec praeter authoris voluntatem in quinto & sexto libro, variis in locis omissa, hoc loco post Operis huius finem poni placuit.

Post Prophetas in Ecclesia Iudæorum, sacerdotio regnante, sectæ originem acceperunt. Ita etiam fit in Ecclesia Christianorum. Nam post pios doctores, Antichristo regnante, sectæ mo-nachorum in ea sunt exortæ. Hæ regem sibi constituerunt[?] Abadonem, Apoc. 9. ut earum hypocri-sim defenderet. Cuius furoris confirmandi robora, ac propagandæ tyrannidis arma, post Lateranense concilium fuerunt, turgida Dominicanorū doctri-na, fucata Franciscanorū sanctitas, Carmelitanorum superstitiones, et Augustinianorū impostura, quæ suis locis habentur. Dominicani enim sub Christianæ prædicationis fuco, Franciscani sub nitæ E-vangelicæ fraude, Carmelitæ sub virgi-nitatis fallacia, Augustiniani sub dolo cœlestis doctrinæ, immo sub Christianæ paupertatis versutia, pro huius sui regis Abadonis regno propagando, omnes simul Sa-thanam induerunt. Ex prædicatione crucis contra Albigenses, Dominicani surgebant, qui statim commentarios ediderant super decreta Papistica.

page.notes: Underlining in several places ("cuius furoris confirmandi robora", "post Lateranense", "Dominicani enim", "Franciscani", "Carmelitæ", "Augustiniani", "sectæ mo") is ink added by a reader, not printed, and is not transcribed as text. Small pointing marks in the left margin beside several lines carry no text. "Nitæ" in "sub nitæ" is uncertain. "Chri-stianæ" at the line end after "Dominicani enim sub" shows no clear hyphen, so it is transcribed without one. "Fran" at the foot is the catchword, read as printed, and may be the start of "Franciscani". The word after "constituerunt" is partly obscured, so it is marked [?].
